description: This file defines the SupportsRuntimeV2Filtering interface, a Java interface in Apache Spark's SQL connector module. It provides methods for runtime filtering of data scans using V2 predicates, including retrieving filterable attributes and applying runtime predicates to prune input partitions.

classes.name: SupportsRuntimeV2Filtering
classes.description: An interface for data sources to support runtime filtering of input partitions using V2 predicates in Spark SQL.

methods.name: filterAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes that can be filtered at runtime by this scan.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies runtime predicates to filter the scan, potentially pruning input partitions.
